description: Pause, activate, or archive a specific opportunity from get_opportunities. State-mutating; guarded by confirm=true. Use this after the merchant has explicitly picked an opportunity to act on. Pass action='activate' to publish a proposed rule, 'pause' to temporarily hide an active one, 'archive' to permanently retire it. Merchant-ops surface: BigCommerce today; on other platforms merchants manage this from the admin, and the tool returns a clear not-available message.

action.description: What to do with this opportunity.

confirm.description: Must be true to dispatch. Guard against accidental triage.

name: triage_opportunity
